scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: Both candidates pass the frozen gates. Candidate 01 has smaller source-relative count and nearest-neighbor deviations while retaining coherent significant immune regions.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 84,327-pixel joint change forms connected authorized stroma-to-immune regions; its 77,529-pixel tissue component preserves adjacent tumor and non-target structures.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 134 class-2 nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 0.692, 1.422, 0.862 and 1.203, with score 0.896.
decisions.coupling: Added immune nuclei remain inside authorized changed tissue; quota, seam, compatibility, distribution and density checks pass.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged.
decisions.limitations: The target population is smaller, more numerous and denser than source, though within the frozen envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish H&E quality; another target for this patient has abstained.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 01 as the single mask-condition handoff.

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass and local score is slightly higher, but candidate 01 has less count inflation and more source-like nearest-neighbor spacing.
